# Member 4

{```{r}
# Test the primary Hypothesis: Whether monetization penalties
# differ for Free-To-Play versus Premium games
# and interpret real-world economic impact

analysis_data <- read.csv("data/processed/analysis_data.csv") 
 
# Model 3: Full model with interaction terms between monetization type and F2P
m3_interaction <- lm( 

    positive_pct ~ cosmetic_only + gameplay_advantage + 
    paywalled_content + is_free + 
    (cosmetic_only * is_free) + (gameplay_advantage * is_free) + 
    (paywalled_content * is_free) + 
    base_price_usd + log_reviews + factor(primary_genre), 

  data = analysis_data 
) 
 
message("=== MODEL 3: FULL INTERACTION MODEL ===") 
print(summary(m3_interaction)) 

```}
